@@ -127,6 +128,10 @@
 If bytes remain after 256 complete records, return `EXTRA_RECORD_LIMIT` before
 reading a 257th header. Success requires the cursor to equal the declared end
 exactly; trailing bytes are not silently treated as padding.
+The loop's error precedence is fixed: while bytes remain, check the 256-record
+cap first, then the four-byte header bound, then the declared data-length bound.
+Thus any remaining tail after 256 complete records yields `EXTRA_RECORD_LIMIT`,
+while exactly 256 records ending at the span boundary succeed.
